verdict.rationale: Numeral offers a free nexus study once you connect your sales channels, and claims continuous exposure monitoring across jurisdictions to identify where you have liability. Its MCP tools expose a per-jurisdiction nexus position with economic thresholds and current sales and transaction counts. This covers the "where do I already owe" part, but nothing shows a backdated dollar estimate of liability, penalties, or interest. Missing for 10: explicit historical transaction import/backfill documentation, estimated back-tax liability amounts per jurisdiction, penalty and interest calculations, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
